via.name: Rope Creek

evidence: The hike begins at the Franz Josef Glacier car park. Follow Douglas Walk, which is an easy, well-formed walking track, until you reach Douglas Bridge across the Waiho River.
The track climbs through open scrubland to a high suspension bridge crossing Rope Creek. The track then continues steadily upwards to Roberts Point.

doubts: Start car park has no feature or name entry (4 km from Franz Josef/Waiau township along Glacier Access Road). Page does not say 'return' in the description; out-and-back taken from DOC's distance 'return via same track'. Hende's Hut is passed but the page says it is unsuitable for overnight accommodation, so not listed as a hut. Many other unbridged creek crossings are mentioned but only Hugh Creek is named. 'Hende's Hut' quote uses a straight apostrophe as in the text ('Hende's Hut' appears in 'at Hende's Hut').
